cross_cutting_candidates.why: Governs the whole codebase and has no resolvable single File:Line for its open half. backend/alembic/versions/2026_08_06_0001_add_analytics_audit_columns.py:31 performs a bare `from migration_helpers import safe_add_column, safe_drop_column` at module scope. Alembic loads revision modules for EVERY command that touches the graph (heads, history, branches, upgrade, downgrade, revision, stamp), so this one import blocks the entire migration toolchain until backend/alembic is on sys.path -- and alembic/env.py:8-10 (which does insert it) is not executed for graph-only commands. At least 6 further revisions import migration_helpers the same way (2026_09_30_0001_add_ticket_attachment_audit_columns.py:20, and others), so the blast radius is every migration operation in CI and deployment, not one file.

The canonical remedy already exists in the codebase at backend/infrastructure/database/mixins.py:14 (`AuditMixin.created_at = Column(DateTime, server_default=func.now(), ...)`), so the whole cluster is one decision: adopt AuditMixin repo-wide. Fixing these 150 one migration at a time would be wrong; it needs a single policy plus one migration per affected table set.
